title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
abstract: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: this https URL

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a graduate course on Embodied Artificial Intelligence, today's lecture is on “SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene.” Recent work such as Uni-NaVid and HarnessVLN reflects a shift toward flexible, language-guided navigation. SuperNav, from researchers at Zhejiang University and collaborating institutions, explores a related direction: using a general-purpose multimodal model inside a structured system of tools and guidance. This matters because robots need to handle changing requests, not just repeat a fixed route. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门具身人工智能的研究生课程上，今天的讲座讲的是“SuperNav：一个能在任何场景下完成任何任务的智能体导航系统”。最近像Uni-NaVid和HarnessVLN这样的工作，反映出一种向灵活、语言引导导航转变的趋势。来自浙江大学及合作机构的研究人员提出的SuperNav，探索的是一个相关方向：在一个由工具和引导构成的结构化系统里，使用一个通用多模态模型。这一点很重要，因为机器人需要应对不断变化的需求，而不只是重复一条固定路线。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, when the paper says “any task in any scene,” does it mean the system is already proven to work universally?
segments.zh: 教授您好，论文里说“任何场景下的任何任务”，这是不是意味着这个系统已经被证明可以普遍适用了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. That phrase describes the aim, not a guarantee of universal reliability. The paper evaluates several kinds of navigation request, including finding a particular object, visiting several targets in order, and interpreting a less direct need. It also tests unfamiliar environments. The central distinction is between task generality, meaning varied requests, and scene generality, meaning unfamiliar surroundings. SuperNav investigates both, while its reported results and limitations define how far the evidence actually reaches.
segments.zh: 不是。这个说法描述的是目标，并不保证它在所有情况下都可靠。论文评估了几类导航请求，包括寻找某个特定物体、按顺序访问多个目标，以及理解一个不那么直接的请求。它还测试了不熟悉的环境。核心区别在于任务通用性，也就是请求的多样性，和场景通用性，也就是不熟悉的环境。SuperNav 对两者都做了研究，而它报告的结果和局限性决定了证据实际能覆盖到什么程度。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The system’s main idea is to let a multimodal large language model, or M-L-L-M, interpret the request and choose among available operations. It can inspect views, turn, navigate to a selected point, update task progress, load guidance, or end the session. The harness passes each operation’s result back to the model, so decisions can change as new observations arrive. This is a reasoning-and-feedback loop, rather than a single prediction of the entire route.
segments.zh: 这个系统的核心思路，是让一个多模态大语言模型（M-LLM）来理解请求，并在可用的操作里做选择。它可以查看视角、转向、导航到指定点、更新任务进度、加载引导信息，或者结束会话。这个框架会把每一步操作的结果传回给模型，所以随着新观察到的信息不断进来，决策也可以随时调整。这是一个推理加反馈的循环，而不是一次性把整条路线预测出来。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what does the harness contribute beyond simply giving the model a set of tools?
segments.zh: 问个简单的问题：除了给模型提供一套工具之外，这个框架还贡献了什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It organizes the interaction and preserves task state. The harness records pending and completed goals, along with a textual history of inspected areas, candidate objects, and failed attempts. It also manages image context: processed image payloads can be removed from later requests while their paths and descriptions remain available. This helps keep a long interaction manageable. The model still decides whether the task is complete or blocked; closing the session does not independently verify that judgment.
segments.zh: 它负责组织交互过程并保存任务状态。这个框架会记录待完成和已完成的目标，以及一个文本形式的历史记录，涵盖已检查区域、候选物体和失败尝试。它还管理图像上下文：处理过的图像数据可以从后续请求中移除，但它们的路径和描述仍然保留。这有助于让长时间的交互保持可控。模型仍然自行判断任务是完成还是受阻；关闭会话并不会独立验证这一判断。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A key interface links visual reasoning to movement. The model chooses one of 4 views—front, right, back, or left—and a normalized image point. The navigation tool then attempts to reach the corresponding location and returns fresh images and execution information. This avoids asking the model to generate low-level motor commands. The same interface can direct either a geometry-based executor or a separately trained movement policy, keeping high-level reasoning relatively independent of the motion backend.
segments.zh: 一个关键接口把视觉推理和移动连接起来。模型从4个视角——前、右、后、左——中选一个，再选一个归一化的图像点。导航工具随后尝试到达对应位置，并返回新的图像和执行信息。这样就避免了让模型生成低层运动指令。同一个接口既能驱动基于几何的执行器，也能驱动单独训练的运动策略，让高层推理相对独立于运动后端。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the model itself is not trained on navigation trajectories, but one movement option is?
segments.zh: 所以模型本身没有在导航轨迹上训练，但其中一个移动选项训练了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The geometry-based executor uses depth, camera calibration, and pose information to select reachable destinations and plan movement; on the real robot, it uses mapping and odometry. The learned executor instead uses images and a marked destination, then predicts short movement sequences and stopping signals. That policy is trained using simulator expert trajectories. So the paper’s claim is specifically that the decision model is not navigation-fine-tuned, not that every component is training-free.
segments.zh: 没错。基于几何的执行器利用深度、相机标定和位姿信息来选择可达目标并规划移动；在真实机器人上，它用的是建图和里程计。而学习到的执行器则使用图像和标记好的目标位置，然后预测短距离移动序列和停止信号。这个策略是用模拟器中的专家轨迹训练的。所以这篇论文的主张具体是说决策模型没有经过导航微调，而不是说每个组件都无需训练。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the system handles abstract requests, where the right target is not named directly?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下系统是如何处理那些抽象请求的吗？也就是目标并没有被直接点明的情况。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is where Navigation Skills provide reusable written guidance. A skill might advise the model to track unexplored branches, recover after a blocked route, recheck a candidate object, or verify completion. The model can load guidance when it seems relevant, but the skill does not enforce actions through fixed program rules. In effect, it is closer to a field guide than an autopilot: it shapes the model’s reasoning while leaving decisions responsive to observations.
segments.zh: 这正是导航技能发挥作用的地方，它提供可复用的书面指导。一项技能可能会建议模型追踪未探索的分支、在路线受阻后恢复、重新检查候选物体，或验证任务是否完成。模型可以在认为相关时加载这些指导，但技能并不会通过固定的程序规则强制执行动作。实际上，它更像一本野外指南，而不是自动驾驶仪：它塑造模型的推理方式，同时让决策保持对观测的响应。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evaluations show both promise and a clear difficulty gradient. On single-object navigation, the geometry-based system reaches 78% success, compared with 34% for the strongest listed baseline. On ordered multi-object tasks, SuperNav reaches 34%, while the listed baselines reach at most 4%. Demand-driven tasks also improve over the strongest listed baseline, but success falls as the number of ordered stages grows. The system completes none of the eligible tasks with 6 or more stages.
segments.zh: 评估结果显示，这套方法既有潜力，也存在明显的难度梯度。在单物体导航任务上，基于几何的系统成功率达到78%，而所列最强基线只有34%。在有序多物体任务上，SuperNav达到34%，而所列基线最高只有4%。需求驱动任务同样优于所列最强基线，但随着有序阶段数量增加，成功率会下降。当阶段数达到6个或更多时，系统无法完成任何符合条件的任务。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does higher success mean the robot also takes more efficient routes?
segments.zh: 成功率更高，是不是也意味着机器人走的路线更高效？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not necessarily. The paper reports success rate and success weighted by path length, or S-P-L, to capture different aspects of performance. On unseen category-navigation episodes, the geometry-based system reaches 73.33% success at a 1-meter threshold, with an S-P-L of 0.4105. The learned executor has similar success rates in these evaluations but much lower S-P-L, indicating less path efficiency. Comparisons across published results also need caution because thresholds, episode subsets, and stopping rules vary.
segments.zh: 不一定。论文报告了成功率和按路径长度加权的成功率，也就是S-P-L，以捕捉不同方面的表现。在未见过的类别导航任务片段上，基于几何的系统在1米阈值下达到73.33%的成功率，S-P-L为0.4105。学习得到的执行器在这些评估中成功率相近，但S-P-L低得多，说明路径效率较差。跨已发表结果进行比较也需要谨慎，因为阈值、片段子集和停止规则各不相同。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The real-robot demonstration uses a Unitree Go two. It shows the robot revising its route around blocked passages, checking candidate targets, and moving between goals. That demonstrates feasibility, but it is not a broad quantitative study of real-world reliability. The authors also test design choices: removing Navigation Skills lowers success on one category benchmark, and limiting the model to a front view reduces performance. These findings suggest that reusable guidance and broad visual context both contribute.
segments.zh: 真机演示用的是宇树Go2。视频里机器人会绕开被堵住的通道、检查候选目标，还会在多个目标之间移动。这说明了可行性，但并不是对真实世界可靠性的大规模定量研究。作者还测试了一些设计选择：去掉导航技能会让某个类别基准上的成功率下降，把模型限制成只有前视角也会拉低表现。这些发现说明，可复用的引导信息和更广的视觉上下文都有贡献。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this approach relate to work like Uni-NaVid, and what should researchers test next?
segments.zh: 这种方法跟Uni-NaVid这类工作有什么关系，研究人员接下来该测试什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Uni-NaVid represents the vision-language-action direction, in which models learn to map video and instructions toward navigation actions. SuperNav instead emphasizes an agent harness: a general-purpose model chooses tools, receives feedback, and uses procedural guidance. Neither framing settles the broader question of reliable autonomy. Future work should test varied real-world environments, longer tasks, inference latency, and semantic errors. It should also examine whether navigation to relevant objects reliably leads to completing the activity the user actually requested.
segments.zh: Uni-NaVid代表的是视觉-语言-动作这条路线，模型学习把视频和指令映射为导航动作。而SuperNav强调的是智能体框架：一个通用模型选择工具、接收反馈，并利用流程性指导来行动。这两种框架都没有解决可靠自主性这个更大的问题。未来的工作应该测试多样化的真实环境、更长的任务、推理延迟以及语义错误。还应该考察，导航到相关物体是否能可靠地最终完成用户真正请求的那项活动。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the strongest takeaway is the system design, rather than a claim that every task is solved?
segments.zh: 所以最强的结论是系统设计，而不是宣称每个任务都已经解决了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is a useful way to put it. SuperNav shows how task interpretation, progress tracking, reusable guidance, and interchangeable movement tools can be assembled around a model that is not fine-tuned specifically for navigation. Its results are encouraging within the evaluated settings, while long sequences and practical deployment remain open challenges. The memorable takeaway is that flexible robot behavior may depend not only on a capable model, but also on the structure that helps it act, learn from feedback, and know when to stop. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 这么说挺到位的。SuperNav 展示的是，任务解读、进度跟踪、可复用引导和可替换的移动工具，可以围绕一个并没有专门为导航做微调的模型组合起来。在评估过的设定里，它的结果令人鼓舞，但长序列和实际部署仍然是待解难题。最值得记住的一点是，灵活的机器人行为可能不仅取决于一个能力强的模型，也取决于那套结构，帮它行动、从反馈中学习，并知道什么时候该停。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
